parts.name: Leg (Left Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of polycarbonate plastic, which is lightweight and durable.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the glasses on the wearer’s ear and helps maintain stability and comfort during use.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge joint to fold or unfold the glasses for wearing or storage.

parts.name: Leg (Right Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of polycarbonate plastic, providing flexibility and strength.
parts.Functional_description: It balances the frame on the wearer’s head and ensures a snug fit behind the ear.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the hinge joint to fold or unfold, similar to the left leg.

parts.name: Base Body (Frame and Lens Assembly)
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the eyeglasses, including the frame and lenses, primarily made of polycarbonate and acrylic materials.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the lenses in place and provides the main structure for vision correction or eye protection.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the central support to which the legs are hinged.
